resources.string: No profiles yet.\nTap + to create your first profile.

NEXORA stores browser metadata locally per profile. Website cookies and storage use AndroidX WebKit named profiles where supported. Bulk profile creation includes a four-step mobile wizard, per-profile User-Agent and proxy assignments, User-Agent and proxy imports, profile groups, startup tabs, fingerprint preferences and advanced settings. Imported proxy credentials are encrypted using Android Keystore. HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 browsing use a loopback relay with upstream authentication; SOCKS4 remains import-only. WebView proxy routing is app-wide, so NEXORA permits only one active browser profile session at a time. IP locale suggestions are user-initiated and routed through the selected proxy. Fingerprint changes remain JavaScript-level, not native Chromium modifications. Portable backups exclude website cookies, history, bookmarks, tabs, downloads and WebView cache.

NEXORA — Private browsing. Total control.

Version 0.4.0-alpha29 (Android vector drawable crash fix)

What is included
- Native identity control center, profile workspace, profile editor and device presets. - Profile Studio: mixed Android and iOS UA-template quantities, random/specific device pools, balanced/random/custom device distribution, saved UA batch reuse, optional sequential proxy assignment and local profile persistence. - Standalone User-Agent Generator: mixed OS batches up to 500, device filters, balanced/random/custom distribution, locale metadata, evidence-backed in-app template support, local batch history, copy/export and direct handoff to Profile Studio. - iOS records are explicitly compatibility UA templates running inside Android WebView; they are not native iOS browser profiles. Only Android Chrome and iOS Safari templates are currently supported unless verified browser templates are added to the catalog.
- Four-step mobile bulk profile wizard for 1–50 profiles.
- Optional HTTPS sync with the NEXORA Next public catalog API, including schema validation, 24-hour startup checks, manual updates and rollback.
- Catalog sync downloads public device data only; it does not upload browser profiles or browsing history.
- Global defaults, per-profile User-Agent/proxy overrides, group names, remarks and startup tabs.
- User-Agent import with OS/browser detection and duplicate checks.
- Proxy import for SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP and HTTPS with encrypted local credential storage.
- Fingerprint preferences, Do Not Track signal, hardware acceleration and image blocking.
- Native browser chrome with an address-first toolbar, tab counter, bottom navigation, saved sessions, bookmarks, history, downloads, advanced find, text zoom and redirects. - Configurable touch sounds, haptic feedback and local download completion/failure notifications.

Engine and limitations
- Built on Android System WebView, a Chromium-based engine supplied by the device. It is not a separately bundled Chromium build.
- Named WebView profiles are required for isolated website storage. If MULTI_PROFILE is unavailable, bulk creation and browser launch are blocked.
- Proxy override is app-wide in this WebView architecture. NEXORA uses a loopback relay for HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5, including HTTP Basic and SOCKS5 username/password authentication; SOCKS4 remains import-only. An exclusive session lease prevents concurrent profiles from overwriting the app-wide route.
- User-initiated IP locale lookup uses ipapi.co through the selected proxy and offers approximate timezone/language suggestions for review. Locale changes remain JavaScript-level; native Android timezone and HTTP Accept-Language are unchanged. - Windows, macOS and Linux browser emulation are not available. iOS presets are emulation only.
- Canvas, WebGL, audio and WebRTC controls remain JavaScript-level. Media-device, client-rect and speech-synthesis controls are not active. Automatic IP-based locale mode and WebRTC Proxy IP mode are unavailable; the opt-in locale suggestion tool only fills custom JavaScript-level values.
- DNT is a browser preference signal, not a guarantee that sites honor it.
- Alpha21 portable backups exclude cookies, website logins, history, bookmarks, tabs, downloads/files, WebView cache and device-bound settings. Restore is additive and may regenerate profile IDs to avoid WebView storage-key collisions. - Automation Center does not include a general browser macro engine, scheduled actions or background website automation. Proxy assignment does not verify connectivity or runtime routing. - Android runtime compatibility, proxy-provider behavior, backup/restore and network-leak behavior can vary by device and WebView provider; test these on your device before relying on the corresponding protections.

Your IP address is changed by your proxy, not by the browser itself.
